name: ccmaf-mods
description: CCMAF mods: Claude Code plugins that streamline the terminal (compact chat, prompt helpers, notifications) and workspace-type kits for the CCMAF app.

plugins.name: ccmaf-board-status
plugins.description: Shows the CCMAF board (in progress / verify counts) in Claude Code's status line.

plugins.name: ccmaf-blank-workspace
plugins.description: Sample workspace type: a general-purpose blank workspace for notes and tasks.

plugins.name: ccmaf-tidy
plugins.description: Keeps the chat short: one green or red line per tool call, details and a prompt list in a pane on the right.

plugins.name: ccmaf-quote-reply
plugins.description: Quote the transcript text you selected into the prompt box as a markdown block quote with /quote.

plugins.name: ccmaf-snippets
plugins.description: Save prompt drafts as named snippets and insert them again later with /snip; kept across sessions.

plugins.name: ccmaf-pc-care
plugins.description: Workspace type for a Windows PC: checks health, tidies up and keeps the setup as files. Changes Windows settings only after asking; journals every change (tier T2).

plugins.name: ccmaf-waiting-notifier
plugins.description: Toast plus sound when Claude is waiting on a permission prompt or question, or finishes a long turn.

plugins.name: ccmaf-status-band
plugins.description: One-line band above the prompt: context %, tool calls vs CCMAF budget class, live turn time, git branch and dirty count.
